title: Egyptian Flatbread with Basil and Wholesome Spread
description: A simple and delicious flatbread recipe from Egypt, topped with fresh basil and a wholesome spread. This flatbread is perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Cut the flatbread into 4 equal pieces.
Spread 1 tablespoon of wholesome spread on each piece of flatbread.
Top each piece with a sprinkle of tian cheese and a few leaves of fresh basil.
Bake in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the flatbread is crispy.
